svg.aria-label: An exploded isometric view of a children's voice device: a rounded rectangular box the size of a paperback, with an off-white top shell and a banana-yellow base. From top to bottom: a red and a green 30 mm arcade button; the top shell with a round speaker grille, a frosted light window and a microphone pinhole; under the lid a 40 mm speaker, a ring of eight colour LEDs, a MEMS microphone board and the two button nuts; the ESP32-S3 board with its USB-C port and a class-D amplifier with wires to the speaker and the switches; the base tray on four rubber feet; and four screws from below.
